summary: Frontend-only UX polish verification for MAZA Vienna. All 6 requested behaviors verified working end-to-end: preloader lifecycle, scroll-spy active nav, hover class attachment, gallery lightbox (open/prev/next/caption/counter/Escape/close), back-to-top visibility+scroll, and reservation inline German validation. No functional regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: Preloader total lifetime is ~3.1s (2100ms delay + 1000ms exit slide). Feels slightly on the long side for repeat visitors; consider sessionStorage gate to only run once per session.

Header nav active-state at very top shows 'Home' active but immediately after any scroll shows 'Über MAZA'. The 'Menü' link is not part of SPY_IDS (home, ueber, galerie, reservierung, kontakt) so it is never highlighted - intentional but worth documenting.

Reservation testids use 'res-<field>' (e.g., res-firstName) prefix while the submit button uses 'reservation-submit-btn' and form uses 'reservation-form' - inconsistent naming; consider unifying to a single prefix for future test stability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend-only site. Preloader body-overflow lock releases at ~3.1s (2100ms + 1000ms exit) — wait >=3.5s before scroll-dependent assertions on fresh load. Reservation field testids are 'res-firstName', 'res-lastName', 'res-email', 'res-phone', 'res-date', 'res-time', 'res-guests', 'res-message'. LazyForms endpoint is real — do NOT submit valid form. Scroll-spy nav items expose data-active='true|false'; 'Menü' link is intentionally excluded from spy IDs.

verified_behaviors.preloader: visible at load; DOM-removed by ~3.1s; body.style.overflow reset to '' after exit
verified_behaviors.scroll_spy: Home active at y=0; Über MAZA active near ueber; Kontakt active after nav click to #kontakt
verified_behaviors.hover_classes: header-reserve-btn, hero-menu-btn, full-menu-btn, contact-call-btn have maza-fill; hero-reserve-btn, contact-route-btn, reservation-submit-btn have maza-lift
verified_behaviors.lightbox: Opens on gallery-item-0 click, caption='Afghanisches Festmahl', counter '01 / 08' -> '02 / 08' on next, back to '01 / 08' on prev, closes on Escape
verified_behaviors.back_to_top: Hidden at top; visible after scrollY>700; clicking returns to y=0 and hides
verified_behaviors.reservation_validation: All 6 err- messages appear in German on empty submit; err-firstName clears after typing; fields accept typing
